records.description:
This long, low-ceilinged tunnel is supported by heavy wooden beams
that run up the walls and cross the ceiling. The tunnel walls
themselves are made of a brownish-red rock, run through with thin
veins of mithril too small to mine.
nd are nearly as thick as leather. This part of the forest has not
een many travelers as it is deep within the forest, far from anything
ivilized. The stench of ancient evil is very thick in the air.

south. The trail slowly vanishes, consumed by a fine, pale sand that
is hot to the touch. A burning wind howls through the valley, sending
small dust-devils whirling about, and whipping the sand up into
clouds that make vision difficult. Laying in its rocky bowl, the
desert waits and hungers, ready to devour the weak and harass those
ersistent enough to venture into its scorching sea.

track, for use in moving mine carts along through the tunnel.

evil-looking swamp plants. The ground consists largely of a rancid
soup, choked with dark mud and filthy water. Twisted black trees poke
through the surface of the bog, clutching like skeletal hands, and a
fine pearly mist cloaks everything in an unnatural silence.
dour, but fortunately it is only knee-deep. The occasional feeling of
omething brushing against you leaves you feeling uneasy.

The earth here is dry and stony, and appears to have been broken by
some incredible force. It is heavily riddled with cracks of varying
size, some nearly wide enough to fit into. The uneven surface makes
footing a little difficult, but it is possible to pick a relatively
safe path. A gaping black chasm splits the earth to the west, so huge
and dark it seems bottomless. Anchored to two large boulders is a rope
nd plank bridge, which spans the chasm to the west.

some incredible force. It is heavily riddled with cracks of varying
size, some nearly wide enough to fit into. The uneven surface makes
footing a little difficult, but it is possible to pick a relatively
safe path. A gaping black chasm splits the earth to the west, so huge

leads off to the east, with smaller ones to the north and south. There
is a vague sense of watchfulness here, and evil.

gaping holes. Occasionally a chunk of rock falls from above or rolls
towards you from further down the tunnel. Because of this footing is

crush you, when instead it is a mere pebble.

records.description:
The cave is quite damp here, with streams of water running down the
black walls and occasional drops of ice cold water dripping from the
ceiling. A variety of harmless fungi and lichen dot the walls, glowing
slightly and letting off just enough light to see by.
oots have fused together in a spidery network. Dense thornbushes and
lose-grown trees block all passage except to the west and southeast.
nd the footprints of scores of beings are set in the torn earth.

than a small section of rock jutting out from the smooth wall beside
you. It is only about a foot across at its widest, and small pebbles
fall away to the ground below you with each step you take. The sound
of what must be large waterfall is almost deafening, its echoing roar
incredibly loud in the grand expanse of this immense cavern. Peering
own in the darkness you can see a fair sized underground river.

You are standing on a narrow stone ledge, which is really nothing more
than a small section of rock jutting out from the smooth wall beside
you. It is only about a foot across at its widest, and small pebbles
fall away to the ground below you with each step you take. The sound
of what must be large waterfall is almost deafening, its echoing roar
incredibly loud in the grand expanse of this immense cavern. Peering
own in the darkness you can see a fair sized underground river.

dark earthen river. It is clean and well-kept, and there doesn't seem
to be many people about for whatever reason. A feeling of unsettling
watchfulness pervades the area, making your hair stand on end.

records.description:
This is a small intersection of streets. There is a guardpost on each
corner of the junction, but other than that it is spartan and clean
like the rest of the city. There don't seem to be many people outside,
as though they had no reason to travel or were too frightened for some
reason or another. Watchful eyes seem to peer out of the eternal
night, making you want to move on quickly.

circular pattern to the centre of the room. Magnificent stone carvings
adorn the walls depicting a cruel and wicked queen of spiders. In the
middle of the room, at the centre of the pit is a smooth granite table
covered in runes. It has restraints for the head, hands and feet, and
is streaked with dried blood. Blinding smoke billow from two urns set
n either side of the table, the scent of burnt flesh rising up.

records.description:
This short pathway appears to be made of cobblestone, small rocks
fitted together to form a relatively smooth roadway. But to your
horror, looking closely you discover you are standing on the tops of
hundreds of skulls! Some are human, some are demi-human, but all have
been cleaned and polished with great care, gleaming sickly in the
darkness. The road leads to the south, where you can see a large
castle, looming ominously, or to the north back to town.

hreatening to rob you of your sanity-- and your soul.

records.description:
This dusty, dirty chamber is long, wide, and high-ceilinged. The
shadows of piles of wooden crates and barrels dance under the
flicking light of torches set in sconces on the walls. Many smells

records.description:
The walls of this narrow passage are cracked and crumbling, and
threaten to cave-in at any moment. The reddish streaks in the walls
are quite pronounced, and darken in colour the deeper the tunnels get.
ff the walls, the sound of water dripping into the lake down from
he stalactites far above can be heard, providing a constant, rhythmic
ackground noise that dulls the senses.
omething brushing against you leaves you feeling uneasy.

burrowed deep down into the earth. They are long and dark and often
bend so that losing one's way is practically inevitable.

librarium_evidence_refs.validation_policy: Accepted because the title was unique, or because duplicate-name file order matched all already-known descriptions in the group.

records.name: Earthen Tunnel

placed_definition.runtime_behavior: spawn each nonzero decoded item into the room at world initialization/reset; do not duplicate an already-persistent instance
placed_definition.fallback: when item values are unavailable, preserve raw descriptor and spawn nothing rather than inventing item ids
placed_definition.save_world_state_impact: high: item spawning and reset duplication can affect persistent world state

evidence_refs.source: MMUD-Explorer
Nightmare Redux field map and MMExplorer source behavior
supporting_evidence: Redux RoomRec has PlacedItems1 through PlacedItems10 as ten 4-byte integers
Redux import/export maps each Placed Item slot independently
MMExplorer reads Rooms.Placed as a comma-separated list and resolves each value as an item record number
evidence_refs.fallback: no item spawn until concrete ids are decoded

evidence_refs.source: Nightmare Redux field map and MMExplorer source behavior
supporting_evidence: Redux RoomRec has PlacedItems1 through PlacedItems10 as ten 4-byte integers
Redux import/export maps each Placed Item slot independently
MMExplorer reads Rooms.Placed as a comma-separated list and resolves each value as an item record number
evidence_refs.fallback: no item spawn until concrete ids are decoded

placed_definition.runtime_behavior: spawn each nonzero decoded item into the room at world initialization/reset; do not duplicate an already-persistent instance
placed_definition.fallback: retain last validated placed-item state and skip invalid/missing item ids; never invent an item id
placed_definition.save_world_state_impact: high: item spawning and reset duplication can affect persistent world state
placed_definition.validation: all positive ids must resolve in Data/Classic/items.json before spawn

tronghold of Khazarad stands proudly under the sky.

ceiling scrolls and intricate wooden wall carvings. Torchieres carved
in the shape of dragons cast a strange half-light upon the room. A
palpable aura of power can be felt here, perhaps the psychic residue
of ancient and disturbing rituals. Rows of woven sitting mats line the
floor, which continues off to the north and east.
